composition.rule: Counts are rolled within their min/max, then adjusted up/down at random until they sum to exactly 6.

notes: Face database for the Tabletop Simulator custom d6 builder. TTS pulls this file (and the icon PNGs) from the GitHub repo via raw URLs. Edit a face here and every table that loads the mod gets the new pool - no Lua change needed.

attacks.effect: Deal 1 damage, twice if lucky (reroll a Miss once).
attacks.name: Acorn Sling

defends.effect: Block 1 damage and feel cozy: heal 1 if unharmed.
defends.name: Knitted Blanket

defends.effect: Block 1 damage and ignore weather/statuses this round.
defends.name: Big Umbrella

misses.effect: So close! The shell cracks, nothing hatches.
misses.name: Cracked Egg

misses.effect: You spend the moment untangling yarn.
misses.name: Tangled Yarn

misses.effect: Distracted by a butterfly. Nothing happens.
misses.name: Butterfly Away

statuses.effect: Apply Poison 1: target takes 1 damage at the start of its next 2 turns.
statuses.name: Sleepy Shroom

statuses.effect: Apply Burn 1: target takes 1 damage now and 1 next turn.
statuses.name: Warm Burn

statuses.effect: Apply Chill: target's next Attack deals 1 less damage.
statuses.name: Chill

statuses.effect: Apply Stun: target skips its next action on a coin flip.
statuses.name: Dizzy Stars

statuses.effect: Apply Bloom (friendly status): heal 1 at the start of your next 2 turns.
statuses.name: Bloom
